- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for new board game recommendations.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These games offer a mix of strategic gameplay, resource management, and building/collecting mechanics.
- [USER] User has been wanting to try Pandemic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pandemic is a cooperative board game with the objective to stop the spread of four deadly diseases.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pandemic is best played with 2-3 players.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Components of Pandemic include:
  - Game board featuring a map of the world with various cities
  - 7 Role cards with unique abilities
  - 48 Infection cards
  - 59 Player cards
  - 4 Disease cubes
  - 1 Infection rate token
  - 1 Outbreaks token
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Gameplay involves choosing a role, setting up the board, taking turns, infecting cities, working together, and winning or losing based on curing diseases or outbreaks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Key mechanics of Pandemic include cooperative gameplay, variable player powers, a modular board, and increasing difficulty.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for new players include communicating, focusing on one disease at a time, and using Role abilities wisely.
- [USER] User is interested in the different roles and their abilities in Pandemic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The 7 Roles in Pandemic are:
  1. Medic
  2. Scientist
  3. Operations Expert
  4. Researcher
  5. Dispatcher
  6. Contingency Planner
  7. Quarantine Specialist
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Operations Expert can move other players' pawns to any city on the board
